title: Source: Beijing-based Naive AI, which plans to release its first AI model as early as this month, is now valued at $1.4B after raising $400M in three rounds (Juro Osawa/The Information)
summary: Juro Osawa / The Information: Source: Beijing-based Naive AI, which plans to release its first AI model as early as this month, is now valued at $1.4B after raising $400M in three rounds — A secretive Chinese AI model startup founded in February by a Tsinghua University professor is now valued at more than $1.4 billion …
